newsitem.title: USA: Berkshire has no reason for stock decline. [CORRECTED 21:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Berkshire has no reason for stock decline. [CORRECTED 21:42 GMT]

text.p: Berkshire Realty Co Inc said Monday it knows of no business reason to explain the unusually heavy trading and the decline in the price of its stock.

The company said it issued the statement in response to shareholder inquiries, commenting "Our reported (second) quarter and year-to-date earnings were in line with expectations and our fundamentals and business prospects remain strong and unchanged."

Berkshire Realty stock closed down 3/4 to 9-7/8 after slipping as low as 9-5/8 on consolidated trading totaling 392,900 shares (corrects from "In late afternoon trading, Berkshire Realty stock was off 5/8 to 10 after slipping as low as 9-5/8 on trading of nearly 2.1 million shares").
The company noted it reported per share funds from operations for the second quarter and first half of $0.26 and $0.52, respectively, compared with $0.25 and $0.50 in 1995.
